evidence.note: Verification is ad-hoc curl-vs-reference on individual endpoints (tags, feeds, posts) with no written checklist of which subsystems pass/fail; coverage exists only as loose recollection.

Notices a real posts_count divergence, calls it 'concerning', investigates briefly, then explicitly moves on to 'other tests' without tracking it as an unresolved failing area — no ledger of open gaps.

After edits to shared handlers.rs (content-type, RSS spacing, markdown rel, 404/405, path parsing) the agent rebuilds and re-tests only the touched endpoint, never re-running previously-passing areas — no regression guard on shared code.

Declares task complete based on a handful of manual matches plus binary-size/start.sh presence, with no coverage accounting of attempted-vs-remaining subsystems (media, FTS search, job queue, pagination largely unverified).

reasoning: The agent maintained only a vague mental picture of parity coverage, sweeping across several subsystems via manual curl comparisons but never keeping a running checklist, distinguishing passing/failing/not-attempted, or re-testing previously-passing areas after touching shared code (matching anchor [3]). It exceeds [0] because it did probe multiple subsystems and noticed individual mismatches, but it never reaches [5]'s maintained, updated checklist, and there is no harness-backed ledger or explicit thrash detection, so the [8]/[10] behaviors are absent.
